title: Cacildes Adventure
description:
WELCOME TO SLEPBONEYour day is finally here - you have received your letter of admission into the king's army. 

Prepare your potions and sharpen your sword, for the many roads of Slepbone await, ready to test your skills.

FIGHT WITH STYLEFight with sword, bow, shield or spells. Dual wield anything. Raise your strength or dexterity to the limits, parry or poke behind a shield, poison or petrify the most deadly of foes.

Every encounter encourages you to use your arsenal in creative ways.

A SOULSLIKE AT ITS COREExplore an interconnected world with many branching paths filled with hidden places and secrets.

Combat requires precision and stamina management - with gear and accessories boosting what you can do in battle.

Find upgrade materials and take your arsenal to the next level at a blacksmith anvil.

Discover all bonfires and rest before the next boss - and do not forget to pick your lost coins upon death!

A WAR IS RISINGDecide the fate of your homeland - the orcs seek a stone that holds their god in captivity; the same stone that feeds life into an elven village.

Will you guide the orcs to their god, or keep beauty intact?

 

EXPANSION: SUNKENLANDReleased in June 2024, this expansion introduces a new area called Sunkenland - explore the slumbering hills of a forgotten land, and find new bosses in the war-torn Obsidian Keep.

EXPANSION: VEILGLADE PENINSULAReleased in September 2024, this expansion introduced swimming and a whole new island to explore - find the curse that haunts the Veilglades, as you explore an hidden crypt, an underwater college and a secret city from which no one has ever returned.

EXPANSION: WHISPERING VALEReleased in December 2025, this expansion introduces a new region called Whispering Vale - explore a forest temple that has been ensnared by the melody of an ancient creature.
description_short: Rise as a knight and decide the fate of your homeland as war looms between orcs and elves.
